doc: Share of the variance lost by a 2x2 box average brought back bilinearly (rows clamp, columns wrap): the image is converted to float64 first, then every step is float64 (floor, clip, bilinear lerp, population variance), so a port is within 1e-9 (numpy against exactly rounded math.fsum sums: < 5e-16 relative). The same map as raw bytes 0..255: the measure is scale-free (scripts/lib/cloud_map_stats.mjs runs on byte maps), so it equals the float case up to the float32 rounding of u8 / 255. Raw u8 input(s): img.

u8_inputs.img: raw bytes 0..255, handed to the function as stored
